Name: Paritee's Treat Your Animals
Author: paritee
Description:
[b]About the Mod
[/b]
Ever wanted to give your horse a cave carrot? Now you can!

Adds the ability to feed your animals (horses, pets and livestock) once per day if you are holding any edible object and interact with them.

[size=1][b]Poisonous Foods[/b]
[/size][list]
[*]Your animals won't actually eat them, but they will lose some friendship points for your attempt!
[*]A few additional foods were added as poisonous for the animals such as Chocolate Cake
[/list]
[b][size=1]Pets[/size][/b]
[list]
[*]Increases friendship for the same amount as filling their water bowl
[/list]
[size=1][b]Horses[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Can optionally turn off friendship tracking in config (enabled by default)
[*]Follows the same percentage increase for friendship as described for pets
[*]﻿Completing socialize quests will also boost friendship points
[*]Counts towards friendship achievements
[*]Affects game complete percentage
[*]Will not show up in the social menu (yet...)
[/list]
[size=1][b]Livestock[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Increases friendship at the same rate as pets
[*]Happiness is increased following the same rules for petting with the Shepherd or Coopmaster profession
[*]Experience is gained at the same rate as petting
[*]Animals become full
[/list]
[b]Install[/b]

[list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]﻿
[*]Unzip the folder into Stardew Valley/Mods
[*]Run the game using SMAPI
[/list]
